name: sabisafe
description: SabiSafe — a private, beginner-friendly crypto companion on Aurora testnet

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev && npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm start
